name: V61 SS Remake Vienna Winter
author: Unity Play
description: A well needed update :) Credits to iDreamSky and SYBO Games for the assets. Keyboard Dev Shortcuts - I for infinite stumbling, L to stop it, J for super high jump, R to stop it, 1 to stop time, 2 to add time, 3 to remove time, B for extra season tokens, z for normal season tokens, space for hoverboard, and K for 888 additional keys
